MT01: Unused catalogs read as version zero without writes; metadata edits preserve original cards, roots and search jobs.
MT02: Replacement snapshots and normalizes input, preserves first member spelling, persists and isolates workspaces.
MT03: Atomic expected-version CAS admits one competing writer and refuses stale replacement.
MT04: Strict bounded catalog validation rejects invalid or duplicate groups without partial replacement.
MT05: Session revocation is checked in the same SQL commit and prevents catalog mutation.
MT06: Populated schema16 upgrades preserve original documents, roots and existing search work.
MT07: Explicit IDs resolve to bounded name-or-member groups with catalog-version pins; unknown IDs fail closed.
